text:
tia: heads-up - runtime rename landed: `model` -> `model_id`. quick sweep needed across docs + examples; found failing tests in go client.

omar: ok. i'll run a language-aware codemod for js/py/go and open a PR.

li: please don't replace variable names `const model =` etc. codemod should only match keyword args / object keys.

omar: yup using parsers. plan: codemod for fenced blocks, manual review for prose, add linter rule.

ci-bot: created branch `docs/param-modelid-sweep` and queued checks.

tia: owner list - omar codemod, li prose review, ci team to run smoke. i'll draft migration blurb and banner.

ci-bot: initial lint found two missed samples in `examples/go`. fixed in PR.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for `docs/param-modelid-sweep` - https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/migration/model-id

tia: smoke tests all green. publishing SDK shim v2.1.1 now. add PR-template checkbox so future renames coordinate with docs.

omar: merged. created follow-up issue to add tutorial-runner guard and i18n heads-up.

li: thanks everyone, closing the loop.
